prompt: Read docs/SPEC.md and docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md first; they are the binding contract. Use only the project venv (.venv/bin/python, .venv/bin/pytest); do not install packages; do not modify anything under tests/ or docs/; do not touch .switch-infra/ or .native/ or any file not listed as your deliverable. Production quality, documented code. Implement scripts/agents.sh and the repo-root Makefile exactly as documented in the docstring of tests/test_ops_scripts.py and AGENTS_SPEC §5. Existing scripts to call (do not modify them): scripts/bootstrap_switch.sh (up|stop), scripts/targets.sh (start [--fresh]|stop|status), `python -m agents.provision`, scripts/run_e2e_demo.py [--cinema] [--fresh]. agents.sh must honour STRANGLER_RUN_DIR (default $ROOT/.state/run) and AGENTS_MODULE_PREFIX (default agents.), map names translator->translator_agent, fuzzer->fuzzer_agent, cutover-gate->cutover_agent, use `set -euo pipefail`, and must never kill processes it did not start (only pids from its pid files, checked alive with kill -0). Makefile: PY ?= .venv/bin/python; install creates .venv with uv and installs the pinned deps from requirements.txt (create requirements.txt with: fastapi==0.115.12, uvicorn[standard]==0.34.2, httpx==0.28.1, hypothesis==6.131.0, pytest==8.3.5, web.py==0.62, pydantic==2.11.4, pyyaml==6.0.2, httpx-sse==0.4.0); test runs `$(PY) -m pytest -q -m 'not integration'`; test-integration runs `-m integration`; e2e runs `$(PY) scripts/run_e2e_demo.py`; cinema runs it with --cinema; stop stops agents, targets and switch; clean-state removes .state/ (except switch.env). Mark all targets .PHONY. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS (binding): (1) agents.sh also has a 'restart' subcommand (= stop then start). Usage line for any other/no subcommand: print 'usage: agents.sh start|stop|restart|status' to stderr and exit 2. (2) Logs are APPENDED (>>) to $RUN/<name>.log, and on every start a header line '=== <ISO-8601 timestamp> start <name> (<module>) ===' is written first. (3) Safety: it must never signal a pid it did not start: only pids read from its own pid files, and only if the pid is alive (kill -0) AND /proc/<pid>/cmdline contains the agent module string (e.g. 'agents.translator_agent' or with AGENTS_MODULE_PREFIX 'tests.fake_agent_translator_agent'); otherwise treat the pid file as stale (status prints '<name> stopped', stop just removes the pid file, start starts a fresh process). stop sends TERM, waits up to 5 s, then KILL, then removes the pid file; idempotent; exit 0. start launches with nohup/setsid in background with PYTHONPATH=$ROOT and cwd $ROOT, writes the pid file, and verifies after ~0.3 s that the process is still alive, else prints an error pointing at the log and exits 1. status prints exactly '<name> running pid=<pid>' or '<name> stopped' for translator, fuzzer, cutover-gate in that order. (4) Makefile: first target 'help' is the default goal (.DEFAULT_GOAL := help) and lists all targets with one-line descriptions (use '## description' comments + awk/grep). 'cinema' runs $(PY) scripts/run_e2e_demo.py --cinema --fresh; 'e2e' runs $(PY) scripts/run_e2e_demo.py --fresh; 'demo' depends on, in this exact order, switch-up targets provision agents e2e where 'demo' recipe runs them sequentially (use sub-make recipe lines so order holds even under make -j: e.g. recipe lines '$(MAKE) switch-up', 'bash scripts/targets.sh start --fresh', '$(MAKE) provision', '$(MAKE) agents', '$(MAKE) e2e') so `make -n demo` prints bootstrap_switch.sh, 'targets.sh start --fresh', 'agents.provision', 'agents.sh start' and run_e2e_demo.py (use $(MAKE) with '+' prefix or inline the commands so that make -n prints them). 'switch-up' = bash scripts/bootstrap_switch.sh up; 'switch-down' = bash scripts/bootstrap_switch.sh stop; 'targets' = bash scripts/targets.sh start; 'provision' = PYTHONPATH=. $(PY) -m agents.provision; 'agents' = bash scripts/agents.sh start; 'agents-stop' = bash scripts/agents.sh stop; 'stop' = agents-stop then bash scripts/targets.sh stop then switch-down (sequential); 'test' = $(PY) -m pytest -q -m 'not integration'; 'test-integration' = $(PY) -m pytest -q -m integration. The scripts' real CLIs: targets.sh start [--fresh]|stop|status ; bootstrap_switch.sh [up|stop]. Everything must be verified with `make -n <target>` for every target and with .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_ops_scripts.py.
acceptance: make -n help demo cinema e2e restart-check >/dev/null 2>&1 || make -n help demo cinema e2e >/dev/null
